summary: Batangas 5th District representative with 41 principal-authored bills. Authored an electricity-sales VAT exemption and an administrative sex and name change for intersex persons; co-authored the national minimum wage.
caveat: Intersex recognition is a single social issue, so social values are unscored. Economic score rests on two thin items.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored VAT exemption on electricity sales (+1, tax relief) and co-authored national minimum wage (-2). Thin and mixed.
